cases.case: The diagram covers the header through its last token, trailing value whitespace included.

tests.text: fails an ishikawa diagram that ends before the trailing whitespace of its last text

cases.case: A rootless diagram covers its header, the selected beta suffix included.

tests.text: fails a rootless ishikawa-beta diagram that ends before its beta suffix

rows.about: A node covers its text through its last descendant; a leaf covers only its text.

cases.case: A node covers its text through its last descendant.

tests.text: fails an ishikawa node that ends at its text before its last descendant
fails an ishikawa node that starts at its indentation

cases.case: The following line terminator is outside it.

tests.text: fails an ishikawa leaf that runs over the line feed after its text

cases.case: `indent` counts tabs and a comment-ending U+2028.

tests.text: fails an ishikawa node indented by a tab whose indentation counts the tab as four
fails an ishikawa node after a comment that ends at U+2028 whose indentation leaves it out

cases.case: `indent` leaves out directives and comment-body whitespace.

tests.text: fails an ishikawa node whose indentation counts the directive before it
fails an ishikawa node whose indentation counts the whitespace of the comment body before it

rows.about: A literal covers its first through last written text character, including quotes

tests.text: fails an ishikawa text whose range leaves out its quotes

cases.case: A literal covers its trailing whitespace.

tests.text: fails an ishikawa text that leaves out its trailing whitespace

cases.case: Its range may span a directive, which its value leaves out.

tests.text: fails an ishikawa text that ends before the directive inside it
fails an ishikawa text that holds the directive inside it

cases.case: Its `RawText` fragments cover the remaining written text.
